latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of apple-mail-search-safe-bak.

- Provides fast, read-only search for Apple Mail.app using SQLite for metadata and AppleScript for full email body.
- Supports searches by subject, sender, recipient, and date with advanced filtering options.
- Enables viewing, opening, and reading full emails directly from the command line.
- Optimized performance (~50ms for 130k emails) compared to slower AppleScript-only solutions.
- Includes safety features such as optional database copy mode to ensure no modification of mail data.
